calculators.name: Injection Molding - Cycle Time
calculators.description: Injection cycle time = (Fill + Pack + Cooling + Mold open/close) x Cycle Time Adjustment Factor (formula registry F-08, ASSUMED). Cooling is the Menges plate-cooling equation, t = s^2 / (pi^2 alpha) x ln((4/pi)(Tm - Tw)/(Te - Tw)), alpha = k / (rho cp) (F-04, ASSUMED: memory/ holds no cooling formula). Fill = shot melt volume / the press injection rate x the injectionTimeAdjustmentFactors for cavities and gates (F-05, VALIDATED). Pack = 35 % of cooling with a 2 s floor, the Menges gate-freeze rule (F-06, ASSUMED: the reference holds no hold time). Mold open/close = the press Euromap 6 dry cycle (F-07, VALIDATED). Not modelled, because the reference has no formula or press data: ejector travel, plasticizing, part and material handling, slides and lifters. Rounded as the engine does: cooling and pack to 0.1 s, fill and the total to 0.01 s.

source.engine: shotMeltVolumeMm3 (part volume x cavities + runner, at melt density)

source.lookup: injectionTimeAdjustmentFactors.Adjustment Factor where Attribute = Cavities Per Mold and Number >= cavities per mold (first bracket)
injectionTimeAdjustmentFactors.Adjustment Factor where Attribute = Gates Per Cavity and Number >= gates per cavity (first bracket)

source.machine: time.dryCycleTimeS (Euromap 6: mold open and close, no material)

fields.name: Mold Wall Temperature
fields.formula: {Mold Temperature} + {Mold Temperature Increase}

fields.name: Thermal Diffusivity
fields.formula: {Thermal Conductivity of Melt} / ({Melt Density} * {Specific Heat of Melt} * 1000) * 1000000

fields.name: Cooling Time
fields.formula: floor({Nominal Wall Thickness} * {Nominal Wall Thickness} / (pi * pi * {Thermal Diffusivity}) * LN(4 / pi * ({Melt Temperature} - {Mold Wall Temperature}) / ({Ejection Temperature} - {Mold Wall Temperature})) * 10 + 0.5) / 10

fields.name: Fill Time
fields.formula: floor({Shot Melt Volume} / {Press Injection Rate} * {Fill Factor for Cavities} * {Fill Factor for Gates} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

fields.name: Pack Time
fields.formula: max({Pack Time Minimum}, floor({Cooling Time} * {Pack to Cooling Ratio} * 10 + 0.5) / 10)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: floor(({Fill Time} + {Pack Time} + {Cooling Time} + {Press Dry Cycle Time}) * {Cycle Time Adjustment Factor} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

calculators.name: Injection Molding - LSR Cycle Time
calculators.description: Liquid silicone rubber cures instead of cooling: Cure Time = A x exp(Ea/R / (T + 273.15)) x wall (Arrhenius, literature constants of Ossipov et al., Polymer Engineering 2002, at a 180 C default mold temperature: F-09, ASSUMED for every LSR grade); no pack phase; Cycle Time = (Fill + Cure + Mold open/close) x Cycle Time Adjustment Factor. The engine uses this variant for LSR materials; no catalog operation maps to it.

source.engine: shotMeltVolumeMm3 (part volume x cavities + runner, at melt density)

source.lookup: injectionTimeAdjustmentFactors.Adjustment Factor where Attribute = Cavities Per Mold and Number >= cavities per mold (first bracket)
injectionTimeAdjustmentFactors.Adjustment Factor where Attribute = Gates Per Cavity and Number >= gates per cavity (first bracket)

fields.name: Cure Time
fields.formula: floor({LSR Pre-exponential Factor} * exp({LSR Activation Energy over R} / ({LSR Mold Temperature} + {Kelvin Offset})) * {Nominal Wall Thickness} * 10 + 0.5) / 10

fields.name: Fill Time
fields.formula: floor({Shot Melt Volume} / {Press Injection Rate} * {Fill Factor for Cavities} * {Fill Factor for Gates} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: floor(({Fill Time} + {Cure Time} + {Press Dry Cycle Time}) * {Cycle Time Adjustment Factor} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

calculators.name: Compression Molding - Cycle Time
calculators.description: Compression cycle = press open/close time (the staged press_cycle_time_s: platen close + open motion) + the material's cure time. Not modelled, because the reference holds no formula: charging, preheat, flash trimming and part handling. The cycle is understated by those until validated formulas are supplied; a grade with no cure time on file contributes none (said in the trace).

source.machine: press_cycle_time_s (the machine's platen close + open motion time)

source.material: cureTimeMin (raw_materials.cure_time_min; absent for a grade with none on file: seeded 0 and said in the trace, the cycle is then understated)

fields.name: Cure Time
fields.formula: {Material Cure Time} * 60

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Press Open/Close Time} + {Cure Time}

calculators.name: Reaction Injection Molding - Cycle Time
calculators.description: RIM cycle = machine dry cycle + fill + cure. Dry cycle = the machine's mold open/close with no material (staged as press_cycle_time_s). Fill Time = Total Shot Volume / Machine Injection Rate (formula registry F-19, ASSUMED: the staged rate over the shot volume is the approved simplification; the reference states no RIM fill formula), with Total Shot Volume = Part Volume x Cavities per Mold in mm3 and the rate in mm3/s, so the result is in seconds. Cure Time = the material's cure or reaction time. Cycle Time = (Dry cycle + Fill + Cure) / Cavities per Mold, per part; the RIM engine prices one part per press cycle (1 cavity). Not modelled, because the reference has no volume or formula: runner and sprue volume, mix-head purge, viscosity, flow resistance, the injection profile, and part handling. A missing or invalid part volume or injection rate makes the cycle a named gap, never a default.

source.engine: the RIM engine prices one part per press cycle: 1

source.material: cureTimeMin (raw_materials.cure_time_min; absent for a grade with none on file: seeded 0 and said in the trace, the cycle is then understated)

fields.name: Total Shot Volume
fields.formula: {Part Volume} * {Cavities per Mold}

fields.name: Fill Time
fields.formula: {Total Shot Volume} / {Machine Injection Rate}

fields.name: Cure Time
fields.formula: {Material Cure Time} * 60

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Machine Dry Cycle Time} + {Fill Time} + {Cure Time}) / {Cavities per Mold}

calculators.name: Injection Molding - Deflashing
calculators.description: Deflashing time = the parting line length / the manual flash trimming rate (formula registry F-24, ASSUMED). The parting line length is the CAD measurement of the PartingLine feature. The rate is the reference variable cmManualFlashTrimmingRate (75), staged for compression molding (Compression Molding:Manual Flash Trimming//PartingLine) and borrowed for injection molding, which has no staged rate. The reference types the rate only as Length/Time; it is read as mm/s, the unit that fits the reference's other Length/Time rates (grindSpeed 381, defaultAviInspectionSpeed 110, cmAirHoseCleaningRateLinear 100) and a manual trim (mm/min would put a 785 mm parting line at over 10 minutes). Routed when the parting line is complex (routing engine); internal cutouts and flash thickness are not modelled. A missing length or rate makes the line a named gap, never a default.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: floor({Parting Line Length} / {Manual Flash Trimming Rate} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

calculators.name: Injection Molding - Slide Movement
calculators.description: The time the hydraulic slides add to each shot, per part (formula registry F-32, ASSUMED: the reference gives the slide speed, slideCycleRate, not the motion): the slides move out and back once per shot, all together, so the longest slide stroke (the CAD SlideBundle stroke) twice over slideCycleRate (Velocity, read as mm/s), shared by the cavities. Lifters ride on the ejector stroke and add no time. A helper: the injection engine runs it for the routed side action and charges it at the press rate.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: floor(2 * {Slide Stroke} / {Slide Cycle Rate} / {Cavities per Mold} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

calculators.name: Injection Mold - Tooling
calculators.description: Injection mold tooling cost (formula registry F-16, F-17, F-18). Mold Cost = the mold base plate steel + the purchased standard components (cmStandardToolingComponents, the side-action hardware only when a slide is needed) + toolroom labour: design hours (cmMoldBaseDesignHours by mold-base area) x the design rate, machining hours (the cavity and core plates at the cmToolMachiningRates plate rate, plus the cmToolMachiningSetups setup hours) x the machining rate, and assembly hours (cmToolAssemblyTimes per component x its quantity) x the assembly rate; the rates are the toolroom rates of digital_factory_settings_usa (memory/ holds USA only). The molds the job wears out are the lifetime shots per cavity over the shots one tool lasts (tblToolLife by material type, else the defaultToolLife variable), at least one; the investment is spread over the parts of the production life. Mold base steel (formula registry F-25, ASSUMED: the reference holds the sizes, borders, plate thicknesses and the steel, not the formula): the smallest standard base (tblStandardMoldBaseSizes) that holds the cavity layout (layoutNumCav, betweenPartsMoldBorder) and the edge borders (tblEdgeMoldBorderX/Y by the press force); the A plate holds aPlateFlatCavityRatio of the part height plus the cavity-plate depth border, at least aPlateMinThickness, the B plate the rest plus the core-plate depth border, at least bPlateMinThickness; with the top clamp, support and bottom clamp plates, the stack is priced as the default tool steel (AISI P20) by mass x its price x its moldBaseCostFactor. The ejector plates and rails have no injection-molding thickness on file and are not included. Cavity and core (formula registry F-26, ASSUMED): machined at tblHrsPerSqInch{Simple,Average,Complex} hours per square inch of part surface, the complexity from the CAD face count against cmMoldSurfaceCountThreshold{Simple,Average} (staged for compression molding and borrowed: the injection process states no rule), times the cavities, at the machining rate; polished to the default cavity finish (defaultCavityFinishIM, SPIFinishes hours per square meter) at the assembly (bench) rate, as no polishing rate is on file. Mold assembly extras (formula registry F-27): the ejector pins, one per areaCoveredPerEjectorPin of the molded area, at the cmStandardToolingComponents Ejector Pin cost plus their cmToolAssemblyTimes hours at the assembly rate; one sprue bushing and one locating ring (sprueBushingCost, locatingRingsCost); the try-out, timePerTryoutBase hours per try-out (twice that on a press over 500 t, as its note states) x defaultNumTryOuts at the tryout rate. Slides and lifters (formula registry F-28, ASSUMED: the reference holds the block volumes and the CMM hours, not the formula): each recognised bundle is a block of its size class ({small,medium,large}{Slide,Lifter}Volume; a bundle a lifter could serve is costed as a lifter), priced as the default tool steel by mass x its price; machined over the surface of a cube of its volume at the cavity hours per square inch and the machining rate; inspected for cmmInspectionMultiplier x the side actions + cmmInspectionAdder CMM hours at the machining rate. Heat treatment (formula registry F-29 version 2): charged only as the tool steel grade needs it (reference/mold-steel-treatment-reference.csv, the costing engineer's research): the steel that forms the part (cavity and core plates, slide and lifter blocks) hardened at heatTreatRateUsdPerKg, the rest of the mold base stress relieved at stressReliefRateUsdPerKg; AISI P20, supplied pre-hardened, is neither. Hot drops (formula registry F-33): on a hot runner, one drop per gate (the cavities x defaultNumberOfGatesPerCavity) at the defaultHotDropType price. Cooling lines (formula registry F-30, ASSUMED: the reference holds the line diameter, the hardware prices and a line drilling rate, not how many lines a mold needs): lines across the cavity plate at 3 x defaultWaterLineDiameter pitch along the mold base length, each the mold base width long, drilled at the cmToolMachiningRates Heater Line Drilling rate and the machining rate, with 2 hoses and 2 fittings per line and one manifold per side. Rib inserts and their EDM (formula registry F-31, ASSUMED: the reference holds the insert sizes, electrodes, burns and hours, not which class a rib is): a rib the CAD engine measured taller than machinedRibThreshold is an insert of the smallest class whose area ({small,medium,large}InsertArea) holds its footprint (length x thickness); its steel is the class area x the core plate height (the variables' notes) as the default tool steel, its pocket machined at the Insert Pocket Machining rate plus the Insert Pocket setup; its electrodes, one graphite electrode of the class size per burn (num*InsertsBurns), at edmMaterialCostCarbonUsdPerIn3, burnt for edmElectrodeVolumeBurn of their volume at the EDM Electrode Burn rate and edmRateUsdPerHr; with the class design hours, the cutter path and spotting hours per insert and the Rib Insert assembly time. Not modelled yet: water baffles (no count on file), and, where they apply, the hot-runner manifold, hot drops (hot runner), cavity inserts (SPI classes tblSpiType builds with inserts) and texture (a cavityTexture other than None) (registry G-03 to G-08).

fields.name: Machining Hours
fields.formula: {Mold Base Area} / 1000000 / {Plate Machining Rate} * 2 + {Plate Setup Hours}

fields.name: Design Cost
fields.formula: {Design Hours} * {Design Rate}

fields.name: Machining Cost
fields.formula: {Machining Hours} * {Machining Rate}

fields.name: Assembly Cost
fields.formula: {Assembly Hours} * {Assembly Rate}

fields.name: Toolroom Labour Cost
fields.formula: {Design Cost} + {Machining Cost} + {Assembly Cost}

fields.name: A Plate Thickness
fields.formula: max({A Plate Min Thickness}, {A Plate Cavity Ratio} * {Part Height} + {Cavity Plate Depth Border})

fields.name: B Plate Thickness
fields.formula: max({B Plate Min Thickness}, (1 - {A Plate Cavity Ratio}) * {Part Height} + {Core Plate Depth Border})

fields.name: Mold Stack Height
fields.formula: {Top Clamp Plate Thickness} + {A Plate Thickness} + {B Plate Thickness} + {Support Plate Thickness} + {Bottom Clamp Plate Thickness}

fields.name: Mold Base Steel Mass
fields.formula: {Mold Base Width} * {Mold Base Length} * {Mold Stack Height} / 1000000000 * {Tool Steel Density}

fields.name: Mold Base Steel Cost
fields.formula: {Mold Base Steel Mass} * {Tool Steel Price} * {Mold Base Cost Factor}

fields.name: Cavity Machining Hours
fields.formula: {Part Surface Area} / 645.16 * {Cavity Machining Hours Per Sq In} * {Cavities per Mold}

fields.name: Cavity Machining Cost
fields.formula: {Cavity Machining Hours} * {Machining Rate}

fields.name: Polish Hours
fields.formula: {Part Surface Area} / 1000000 * {Polish Hours Per Sq Meter} * {Cavities per Mold}

fields.name: Polish Cost
fields.formula: {Polish Hours} * {Assembly Rate}

fields.name: Ejector Pins
fields.formula: CEIL({Mold Base Area} / {Area Per Ejector Pin})

fields.name: Ejector System Cost
fields.formula: {Ejector Pins} * ({Ejector Pin Cost} + {Ejector Pin Assembly Hours} * {Assembly Rate})

fields.name: Sprue and Locating Ring Cost
fields.formula: {Sprue Bushing Cost} + {Locating Ring Cost}

fields.name: Tryout Hours
fields.formula: {Tryout Base Hours} * {Tryout Press Multiplier} * {Number of Tryouts}

fields.name: Tryout Cost
fields.formula: {Tryout Hours} * {Tryout Rate}

fields.name: Side Action Steel Mass
fields.formula: ({Slide Block Volume} + {Lifter Block Volume}) * 16387.064 / 1000000000 * {Tool Steel Density}

fields.name: Side Action Steel Cost
fields.formula: {Side Action Steel Mass} * {Tool Steel Price}

fields.name: Side Action Machining Hours
fields.formula: {Side Action Block Surface} * {Cavity Machining Hours Per Sq In}

fields.name: Side Action Machining Cost
fields.formula: {Side Action Machining Hours} * {Machining Rate}

fields.name: Side Action CMM Hours
fields.formula: IF({Side Actions} > 0, {CMM Hours Per Side Action} * {Side Actions} + {CMM Base Hours}, 0)

fields.name: Side Action CMM Cost
fields.formula: {Side Action CMM Hours} * {Machining Rate}

fields.name: Side Action Cost
fields.formula: {Side Action Steel Cost} + {Side Action Machining Cost} + {Side Action CMM Cost}

fields.name: Cavity Core Plate Mass
fields.formula: {Mold Base Width} * {Mold Base Length} * ({A Plate Thickness} + {B Plate Thickness}) / 1000000000 * {Tool Steel Density}

fields.name: Hardened Steel Mass
fields.formula: {Cavity Core Plate Mass} + {Side Action Steel Mass}

fields.name: Stress Relieved Steel Mass
fields.formula: {Mold Base Steel Mass} - {Cavity Core Plate Mass}

fields.name: Heat Treatment Cost
fields.formula: {Hardened Steel Mass} * {Heat Treat Rate} * {Hardening Applies} + {Stress Relieved Steel Mass} * {Stress Relief Rate} * {Stress Relief Applies}

fields.name: Water Lines
fields.formula: max(1, floor({Mold Base Length} / ({Water Line Pitch Factor} * {Water Line Diameter})))

fields.name: Water Line Drilling Hours
fields.formula: {Water Lines} * {Mold Base Width} / {Line Drilling Rate} / 60

fields.name: Cooling Cost
fields.formula: {Water Line Drilling Hours} * {Machining Rate} + {Water Lines} * 2 * ({Water Hose Cost} + {Water Fitting Cost}) + 2 * {Water Manifold Cost}

fields.name: Rib Insert Steel Volume
fields.formula: {Rib Insert Area} * 645.16 * {B Plate Thickness}

fields.name: Rib Insert Steel Cost
fields.formula: {Rib Insert Steel Volume} / 1000000000 * {Tool Steel Density} * {Tool Steel Price}

fields.name: EDM Burn Hours
fields.formula: {Rib Insert Burned Volume} * 16387.064 / {EDM Burn Rate} / 60

fields.name: EDM Cost
fields.formula: {EDM Burn Hours} * {EDM Rate} + {Rib Insert Electrode Volume} * {Electrode Material Cost}

fields.name: Rib Insert Pocket Hours
fields.formula: IF({Rib Inserts} > 0, {Rib Insert Steel Volume} / {Insert Pocket Rate} / 60 + {Insert Pocket Setup Hours}, 0)

fields.name: Rib Insert Labour Cost
fields.formula: {Rib Insert Design Hours} * {Design Rate} + ({Rib Inserts} * {Cutter Path Hours Per Insert} + {Rib Insert Pocket Hours}) * {Machining Rate} + {Rib Inserts} * ({Spotting Hours Per Insert} + {Rib Insert Assembly Hours}) * {Assembly Rate}

fields.name: Rib Insert Cost
fields.formula: {Rib Insert Steel Cost} + {EDM Cost} + {Rib Insert Labour Cost}

fields.name: Hot Drop Cost
fields.formula: {Hot Drops} * {Hot Drop Unit Cost}

fields.name: Mold Cost
fields.formula: {Purchased Components Cost} + {Toolroom Labour Cost} + {Mold Base Steel Cost} + {Cavity Machining Cost} + {Polish Cost} + {Ejector System Cost} + {Sprue and Locating Ring Cost} + {Tryout Cost} + {Side Action Cost} + {Heat Treatment Cost} + {Cooling Cost} + {Rib Insert Cost} + {Hot Drop Cost}

fields.name: Lifetime Shots
fields.formula: {Annual Volume} / {Cavities per Mold} * {Production Life}

fields.name: Molds Required
fields.formula: max(1, CEIL({Lifetime Shots} / {Tool Life Shots}))

fields.name: Tooling Investment
fields.formula: floor({Mold Cost} * {Molds Required} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

fields.name: Tooling Cost Per Part
fields.formula: floor({Tooling Investment} / ({Annual Volume} * {Production Life}) * 10000 + 0.5) / 10000
